main.scope: Physical H1; 20-second quiet wait, bounded endpoint reads. PC time is the FPS denominator; native clock stores last-frame timestamps and can lag at low FPS.

options.scope: Physical H1; 20-second quiet wait, bounded endpoint reads. PC time is the FPS denominator; native clock stores last-frame timestamps and can lag at low FPS.

first_reward.scope: Physical H1, first reward detected by read-only observation; four-second quiet wait, bounded endpoints. Snapshot captured before timing and downloaded after it.

transfer.scope: SCREEN_READ RPCs; protocol framing included, USB packet overhead excluded

return_main.scope: Physical H1; 20-second quiet wait, bounded endpoint reads. PC time is the FPS denominator; native clock stores last-frame timestamps and can lag at low FPS.

scope: Main/options/return main use 20-second quiet windows; saved and ordinary battle 8 seconds; reward 4/12 seconds; intro preview/sod 1.2 seconds and actual camera motion 0.6 seconds. Read-only endpoints and ordinary touches; no game RAM modifications. Panoramas cover early first-adventure daytime levels 1–4; later levels and dense battles not covered.
